C-02.title: The Two of Cups
C-02.upright: Unity. Relationships. Balance. Partnership. Friendship. Cooperation. Relationship bonds and commitments that offer harmony and support.
C-02.reversed: Miscommunication. Suggests a loss of balance in relationship caused by miscommunication. Codependency.

C-03.title: The Three of Cups
C-03.upright: Celebration. Camaraderie. Joyful occurrences. Friendship and family bonds are honored and supported, particularly feminine ones. Social events and gatherings are recognized.
C-03.reversed: Overreliance on friends. Premature celebration. Distracting yourself from something you would rather not be doing or from emotional or sexual dissatisfaction. Seeking approval.

C-04.title: The Four of Cups
C-04.upright: Rest. Reflection. Boredom. Detachment. Apathy. Indicates ignored opportunities. Open doors may be overlooked while focus is diverted.
C-04.reversed: Signifies a readiness to reengage with your life and start saying yes again, even to new relationships. Dissatisfaction. Moving on.

C-05.title: The Five of Cups
C-05.upright: Grief. Sorrow. Mourning. Disappointment. Ruminating. One may be stuck on past trauma or feeling sad and regretful, while not appreciating what remains.
C-05.reversed: Pain of Five of Cups intensifies. Overwhelming loss. Recovering from grief. Can signify progress in healing from a loss. Getting support.

C-06.title: The Six of Cups
C-06.upright: Childhood comforts. Nostalgia. Reminiscing about happier times or childhood. Shows elements of joyful innocence, sharing, playful energy, childlike wonder.
C-06.reversed: Lost in nostalgia. You may see your past through rose-colored glasses at the expense of your present life. Unhappy childhood memories.

C-07.title: The Seven of Cups
C-07.upright: Fantasy. Creativity. Temptation. Dreaming without action. Being caught up in overthinking or overwhelmed by thoughts or the many options to choose from.
C-07.reversed: Delusion. Fantasy. You might be fooled by appearances, idealizing someone or something. Choosing to believe fantasy over reality. Resisting temptation.

C-08.title: The Eight of Cups
C-08.upright: Leaving. Wandering. Seeking. Walking away from what no longer serves us. Contemplation or moving on is needed. Avoidance of feeling unfulfilled may also arise.
C-08.reversed: Drifting. You may be endlessly traveling, wandering, leaving, and abandoning situations too soon. Lack of patience. Returning home from a spiritual search.

C-09.title: The Nine of Cups
C-09.upright: Hosting. Welcoming. Enjoyment. Wishes being granted. Success. Feelings of contentment or gratitude for one's blessings.
C-09.reversed: Undeserving of enjoyment. Overindulgence. Either indicates that you don't feel you deserve to enjoy yourself or that you may need to share more.

C-0A.title: The Ace of Cups
C-0A.upright: Love. Joy. Spirituality. Compassion. Abundance of emotion and creativity. Beginning of new creative endeavors and relationships.
C-0A.reversed: Spiritual egotism. Suggests hindrances to spiritual growth caused by being too literal about your practice. Creative, emotional, spiritual, or physical infertility.

C-10.title: The Ten of Cups
C-10.upright: Family love. Togetherness. Joy. Emotional fulfillment and happiness, including in relationships. Alignment. Balance. Wholeness.
C-10.reversed: Family love. Threat to harmony. Distracted by ideals. Indicates love and togetherness, but your ideal of what family "should" look like may sidetrack you from the joy in your life.

C-J1.title: The Page of Cups
C-J1.upright: Innocent. Imaginative. Dreamer. Inspiring news. Being open to new opportunities and creativity. Spiritual or intuitive connections. Receiving messages.
C-J1.reversed: Naive. Irresponsible. Impulsive. Too immersed in emotions to notice others.

C-J2.title: The Knight of Cups
C-J2.upright: Romance. Idealism. Passion. Inspiration. Daydreaming. Fantasies. Creativity. Appreciation for the beauty of life, charm, and a leisurely pace.
C-J2.reversed: Hesitant to act or express emotions. Creative, emotional, or spiritual block due to disappointment or fear of rejection. Possessive in a relationship.

C-KI.title: The King of Cups
C-KI.upright: Calm. Shoulder to cry on. Symbolizes mastering one's emotions and creative achievement. Compassion. Balancing emotion with logic.
C-KI.reversed: Insecurity. Shame. Hatred. Betrayal. Seeks emotional balance.

C-QU.title: The Queen of Cups
C-QU.upright: Nurturing. Healing. Compassion. Love. Empathy. The Queen is intuitive, creative, contemplative, and in charge of emotions.
C-QU.reversed: Depression. Victimhood. Draining. Reversed Queen of Cups neglects to love herself. Can be manipulative or draining.

P-02.title: The Two of Pentacles
P-02.upright: Juggling. Balancing. Shows the need for balance and flexibility.
P-02.reversed: Suggests work and life imbalances, you are drained and overwhelmed, or the double life you may lead doesn't align with your values or everyone's happiness.

P-03.title: The Three of Pentacles
P-03.upright: Meaningful work. Collaboration. Renown. Signifies working with others toward a goal, the early stages of a project, or learning new skills.
P-03.reversed: Tedium and mediocrity, particularly in matters of career. Exhaustion. Burnout.

P-04.title: The Four of Pentacles
P-04.upright: Security. Miserliness. Denotes conservation or protection of assets. One may be closed off emotionally or holding tightly to energy or possessions, or strict with finances.
P-04.reversed: Financial need. Indicates a real need to pinch pennies or an extremely miserly attitude.

P-05.title: The Five of Pentacles
P-05.upright: Hardship. Community. Resilience. Speaks of feeling isolated, left out, or lacking. One may have fallen on hard times, feel they don't have enough, or lack security.
P-05.reversed: Physical or financial recovery. Denotes bouncing back from an illness or an emotional or financial loss.

P-06.title: The Six of Pentacles
P-06.upright: Generosity. Social justice. Symbolizes giving and receiving. Encouragement to share abundance, help those in need, or be willing to accept support.
P-06.reversed: Suggests you are taking someone's generosity for granted or that someone else is making light of your generosity. Take good care of your resources and appreciate what you have.

P-07.title: The Seven of Pentacles
P-07.upright: Investment. Uncertainty. Patience. Refers to holding a vision or focusing on long-term goals. Planning, perseverance, and knowing that an end goal is near.
P-07.reversed: Avoiding responsibility. Indicates that you may be refusing to look at your financial situation or you are evading a reality check about the progress of an important project.

P-08.title: The Eight of Pentacles
P-08.upright: Hard work. Concentration. Education. Training. Reveals progress and dedication to a craft. Mastering skills, studying further, and fine-tuning situations.
P-08.reversed: Unsatisfying career. You are either working too hard or not hard enough. You may feel that your work is not satisfying or right for you.

P-09.title: The Nine of Pentacles
P-09.upright: Retirement. Prosperity. Comfort. Symbolizes affluence and abundance. Financial security. Being able to provide for oneself. Decadence. Achievement.
P-09.reversed: Loneliness. Regretful. You may have focused much of your life on your career and are now experiencing regret that you did not do more to cultivate your relationships.

P-0A.title: The Ace of Pentacles
P-0A.upright: Perfection. Contentment. Prosperity. Abundance and security, particularly with new opportunities. Manifestation is likely with hard work and planning.
P-0A.reversed: Financial disappointment. Materialism. Can reveal an unhealthy love of money, mismanagement, wastefulness, or inflexible financial expression.

P-10.title: The Ten of Pentacles
P-10.upright: Generations. Community resources. Foundation. Wealth. Inheritance. Success. Accomplishment. Providing for family and prosperity.
P-10.reversed: Family conflict over finances, property, or values. Reveals imbalance, tension, or outright conflict among generations of family or community.

P-J1.title: The Page of Pentacles
P-J1.upright: Apprentice. Diligence. Awe. Good news about money. Depicts new opportunities of a material nature. Speaks to the initial planning and manifesting of ideas and projects.
P-J1.reversed: Materialistic. Wasteful. Less diligent. May bring unwelcome financial news or unhappy news about your property.

P-J2.title: The Knight of Pentacles
P-J2.upright: Provider. Responsible. Constructing. Secure. The Knight works hard, with diligence, conservation, and commitment. Stays the course.
P-J2.reversed: Inertia. Stubbornness. Too cynical and cautious to be motivated to do much of anything. Might be miserly with money. Neglects to care for people. Focuses on materialistic desires.

P-KI.title: The King of Pentacles
P-KI.upright: Provider. Established. Security. Portrays material success, leadership, and wealth. The King is prosperous, a confident provider, and represents fulfilled goals and ventures.
P-KI.reversed: Greed. Materialism. Corruption. Gambling. Reversed King of Pentacles has lost sight of the purpose of managing resources well.

P-QU.title: The Queen of Pentacles
P-QU.upright: Resourceful. Pragmatic. Generous. Embodies abundance and nurturing. The Queen is practical, successful, and caring toward loved ones. Warmth. Love. Security.
P-QU.reversed: Dependent. Mismanaging. Might neglect or mismanage resources, or even find themselves in debt. Can go overboard in fulfilling their role—caring for everyone but themselves.

S-02.title: The Two of Swords
S-02.upright: Indecision. Irresolution. Intuition. Represents choice or the inability to decide.
S-02.reversed: Poor judgment. Choosing sides. Can indicate making up your mind after a period of indecision. In partnerships, can suggest manipulation, deception, and fundamental incompatibility.

S-03.title: The Three of Swords
S-03.upright: Sadness. Heartbreak. Catharsis. Symbolizes grief, sorrow, and mourning. The need to release emotion.
S-03.reversed: Mitigated pain, possibly caused by the extremes of the Sword traits: overthinking, abstrating, or compartmentalizing.

S-04.title: The Four of Swords
S-04.upright: Recovering. Illustrates pausing, resting, or taking a step back. Calls for reflection or contemplation.
S-04.reversed: Long recovery. You may need to take time off work and come to terms with spending more time resting.

S-05.title: The Five of Swords
S-05.upright: Failure. Sadness. Disappointment. Signifies conflict or feelings of defeat.
S-05.reversed: Emphasizes unfairness of the fight at hand. Can indicate being on either side of a case of bullying or oppression.

S-06.title: The Six of Swords
S-06.upright: Travel. Perspective. Moving on. Symbolizes leaving the past behind and moving forward. Transitions and releasing of baggage.
S-06.reversed: Stuck in a rut. Can indicate difficulty getting away or escaping from a difficult situation.

S-07.title: The Seven of Swords
S-07.upright: Sneaking. Calculating. Stealing. Represents deception, betrayal, and feeling cheated. Strategy. Creating boundaries and prioritizing oneself.
S-07.reversed: Indicates that you are doing something unethical or signifies that you are dealing with dishonest, untrustworthy people.

S-08.title: The Eight of Swords
S-08.upright: Paralysis. Constraint. Ostracism. Indicates feeling helpless, stuck, or trapped by one’s own perspective or circumstances.
S-08.reversed: Paralyzing indecision. Release. You find yourself extremely incapacitated, or your mental indecision or isolation echoes through your emotions as shame, guilt, or regret.

S-09.title: The Nine of Swords
S-09.upright: Panic. Insomnia. Portrays anxiety, sleepless nights, and excessive worry. This card reminds one to gain perspective and know their fears may be out of proportion.
S-09.reversed: Pulling through. Assures you that you have already experienced the lowest point of mental anguish. The worst of this period is behind you.

S-0A.title: The Ace of Swords
S-0A.upright: Intellect. Success. Decisions. Depicts new ideas and mental clarity. Purpose, action, and clear thoughts. There may be emerging ideas, revelations, or opportunities.
S-0A.reversed: Conflict. Abuse of power. Positive assertiveness of upright Ace of Swords turns into conflict and destructive uses of power.

S-10.title: The Ten of Swords
S-10.upright: Betrayal. Backstabbing. Release. Symbolizes rock bottom and difficult endings. A cycle of hard times is coming to an end, or one needs to find acceptance and self-help.
S-10.reversed: Culpability. More crises to come. Indicates that you might be at least partly culpable for the terrible way things have gone.

S-J1.title: The Page of Swords
S-J1.upright: Clever. Competitive. Minor power play. Represents new methods of communication, exploration, or new ideas. Curious. A cautious, tense, or careful approach.
S-J1.reversed: Gossip. Manipulation. You may be more worried about your reputation than on developing your own intellect, or spreading gossip about someone to tarnish or manipulate them.

S-J2.title: The Knight of Swords
S-J2.upright: Intelligent. Confrontation. Advocate. Portrays swift action and ambition. The Knight moves with motivation and assertiveness. Quick thinking and intellect.
S-J2.reversed: Suggests you or someone in your life is causing conflict and imbalance by shoving an idea down others’ throats. Can signal excessive enthusiasm and getting carried away with ideas.

S-KI.title: The King of Swords
S-KI.upright: Professional. Rational. Ambitious. Authority. Command. Intelligence. Mental power. Truth. Expert advice and logical thinking.
S-KI.reversed: Without mercy. Abuse of power. Overly competitive. Ambition and authority turn ruthless.

S-QU.title: The Queen of Swords
S-QU.upright: Discerning. Independent. Intelligent. Boundaries. Truth. Directness. The Queen is strong and has keen insight.
S-QU.reversed: Spiteful. Wounded. Reversed Queen nurses resentment, holds grudges, and keeps score. Elitist. Pessimistic. Hurts others in ways they’ve been hurt. Closed-minded. Cruel.

T-00.title: The Fool
T-00.upright: The beginning of a journey. Innocence. Taking a leap of faith. Optimism. New beginnings. Adventure. Risk-taking.
T-00.reversed: Impulsive. Inhibited. If you have been going overboard in your adventures, it is time to rein it in before someone gets hurt. If you haven’t gone out or had fun in a while, do something fun.

T-01.title: The Magician
T-01.upright: Manifestation. Spiritual connection. Creativity. Ability. Represents having everything you need inside of you to accomplish your dreams.
T-01.reversed: Abuse of power. Powerlessness. Watch out for someone who may be charming you in order to take advantage of you. Maintain integrity. Be creative if stuck.

T-02.title: The High Priestess
T-02.upright: Intuition. Self-knowing. Divine knowing. The subconscious. Inner truth. Duality. A reminder to go within.
T-02.reversed: Secrecy. Deception. Ignored intuition. You may be keeping a secret to deceive someone, or someone is hiding something from you. You may be ignoring or denying your spirituality.

T-03.title: The Empress
T-03.upright: Nurturing. Abundance. Elements of femininity, caring, Mother Earth, fertility. Motherhood. Creativity. Beauty.
T-03.reversed: Difficulties with motherhood or relationship with mother or mother figure. Creative blocks that result from denying relationship with beauty, pleasure, art, and inner child.

T-04.title: The Emperor
T-04.upright: Solid foundations. Authority. Strength. Power. Leadership. Influence. Structured order. Reliability. Fatherhood. Responsibility.
T-04.reversed: Unreliability. Coup. Revolution. Time to become more assertive, decisive, and attentive to schedules, materials, and productivity.

T-05.title: The Hierophant
T-05.upright: Tradition. Conformity. Education. Knowledge. Encompasses organized groups and religions. Concept of being confined by structures.
T-05.reversed: Poor leadership. Being misled by an egotistical authority figure. A free-spirited visionary permitting you to forge your own path.

T-06.title: The Lovers
T-06.upright: Balance. Unity. Love. Fulfillment. Choice. Can refer to relationships or self-love, choices, and inner alignment.
T-06.reversed: Temptation. Indecision. Betrayal. Uncertainty. Confusion. Disrespect. A time to take a deep breath and grow beyond past circumstances or temptations.

T-07.title: The Chariot
T-07.upright: Motion. Moving forward. Momentum. Breakthrough. Aspects of staying the course, taking action, or an outcome leading to victory. Travel.
T-07.reversed: Loss of control. Disappointment. Indulgence. Egotism. Ask for help to get yourself on a healthy and creative path.

T-08.title: Strength
T-08.upright: Strength. Courage. Compassion. Perseverance. Power. Speaks to taming the chaos around you and staying strong. Graceful calm. Determination.
T-08.reversed: Forceful. Passive. Signals that you are being too forceful or too passive in response to conflict.

T-09.title: The Hermit
T-09.upright: Signifies the need to go within or be alone. Need to connect to oneself on a deeper or more spiritual level. Self-reflection. Wisdom. Inner voice.
T-09.reversed: Closed off. You might be too adamant about setting your schedule or giving the appearance of pursuing spiritual practice. You may be judging wisdom being shared with you.

T-10.title: The Wheel of Fortune
T-10.upright: Good luck. Karmic turns. A turning point is approaching or a cycle is shifting direction. Change. Patterns.
T-10.reversed: A standstill. Closure. Resisting fate. Anything you try to avoid will inevitably come back to haunt you.

T-11.title: Justice
T-11.upright: Truth. Fairness. Wrongs are made right and justice is upheld. Accountability. Repercussions for actions. Balance. Objectivity. Equity.
T-11.reversed: Undue feelings of injustice. Outcome of this situation is best and most fair for all involved. At an extreme, this lack of perspective manifests as prejudice, bias, or injustice.

T-12.title: The Hanged Man
T-12.upright: Perspective. Waiting. Pause or period of limbo, or the need to observe situations from a different angle. Trust. Self-sacrifice.
T-12.reversed: Despair. Loss of faith. Undue self-sacrifice. Hang-ups and injustices that plague your spirit, convincing you to lose trust in yourself or in the divine. Sacrificing yourself out of habit.

T-13.title: Death
T-13.upright: Endings. Grief. Transformation. Change. Transitions are occurring and something is ending to make way for something new. Rebirth.
T-13.reversed: Fear. Confusion. Resisting transformation. Refusal to accept an ending.

T-14.title: Temperance
T-14.upright: Balance and patience. Creativity. Art. Healing. Moderation is needed. Stay calm and keep to the middle ground.
T-14.reversed: Imbalance. Indulgence. Deprivation. Take steps to restore balance.

T-15.title: The Devil
T-15.upright: Vitality. Play. Temptation. Oppression. Represents attachment and our shadow selves. We see that we can break free of addictions or temptations and that we are not powerless.
T-15.reversed: Release. Severance. Freeing yourself. Finding that you are not as trapped as you first thought you were.

T-16.title: The Tower
T-16.upright: Destruction. Consequences. Catastrophe. Detoxification. Shows sudden change, crumbling of structures or foundations to make way for rebuilding the new.
T-16.reversed: Caught in the cross fire. You are affected by someone else’s experience of destruction and collapse in their own life. Others’ mistakes do not have to limit your spirit.

T-17.title: The Star
T-17.upright: Guiding vision. Healing, Creativity. Promise and hope. Dreams can come true. A message of faith or a period of peaceful calm and blessings.
T-17.reversed: Naivete. Obliviousness. Cynicism. Sense of hope, idealism, and possibility are latent. You or others are ignoring solutions and remedies that are possible if you allow yourself to hope and believe.

T-18.title: The Moon
T-18.upright: Dreams. Instinct. Crisis. Mystery and illusion. What is hidden is surfacing, and not everything is as it appears. Asks you to trust your intuition.
T-18.reversed: Trauma. Emotional buildup. Caught in old patterns. Rather than exploring your subconscious, you ignore it. Tamping down your intuition, getting yourself into trouble.

T-19.title: The Sun
T-19.upright: Joy. Positivity. Health. Children. Happiness and successful outcomes. Better times approaching.
T-19.reversed: Reversed meaning can be the same as upright definition. Can suggest loss of or difficulties concerning something cherished.

T-20.title: Judgment
T-20.upright: Criticism. Absolution. Rebirth and life purpose. Asks one to follow their true calling, release self-judgment, and become new as the end goal approaches.
T-20.reversed: Overly critical. Kills any possibility of spiritual awakening.

T-21.title: The World
T-21.upright: Completion. Fulfillment. Wholeness. Celebration. Success is at hand, and a cycle has been accomplished. Triumph and achievement.
T-21.reversed: The need to work within limitations. Find freedom within your circumstances.

W-02.title: The Two of Wands
W-02.reversed: Bad timing. Initial success without follow-through. Misplaced trust in a partner, mentor, gatekeeper, or guide. Feelings of having failed to surpass the achievements of a parent figure.

W-03.title: The Three of Wands
W-03.upright: Project launch. Productivity. Reflection and progress with endeavors. Broadening your horizons. Expansion. Thinking outside the box.
W-03.reversed: Delays amid success. Mild disappointments. Communication problems. Setbacks and delays due to competition in the field, carelessness, or lack of balance between action and planning.

W-04.title: The Four of Wands
W-04.upright: Celebration. Security. Peace. Happiness. Unity. Can refer to engagements, marriage, and important milestones. Harmony. Balance.
W-04.reversed: Carries the same meaning as upright card. Can indicate something or someone putting a damper on the party.

W-05.title: The Five of Wands
W-05.upright: Competition. Conflict. Chaos. Jealousy. Chaotic energy. Tension. Differences of opinion.
W-05.reversed: Ignoring or suppressing conflict. Can carry the opposite meaning, suggesting resolution and reconciliation.

W-06.title: The Six of Wands
W-06.upright: Victory. Validation. Messengers and messages. Triumph. Success. Confidence. Achieving goals. Receiving recognition for accomplishments.
W-06.reversed: Reward or promotion has been postponed but will still arrive. Can indicate being let down by someone.

W-07.title: The Seven of Wands
W-07.upright: Courage. Self-defense. Forcefulness. Stubbornness. Struggle and perseverance. Vigorous energy and defense against challenges.
W-07.reversed: Conflict avoidance. Reluctance. Insecurity. Indecisiveness. Feelings keeping you from defending yourself.

W-08.title: The Eight of Wands
W-08.upright: Action. Movement. Acceleration. Communication. Sudden and swift change. Good results after quick developments.
W-08.reversed: Procrastination. Suggests that you are running yourself into the ground with nonstop, senseless activity. Refusal to prioritize. Burnout.

W-09.title: The Nine of Wands
W-09.upright: Guarding. Protecting. Defending. One’s faith is being tested. Struggle is almost over. Perseverance. Endurance. Resilience in times of difficulty.
W-09.reversed: Feeling discouraged and exhausted from fighting. Giving in. Unreasonable or demanding person or people in your life have not backed down.

W-0A.title: The Ace of Wands
W-0A.upright: Creative drive. New projects and ideas. Exciting and creative new beginnings. Inspiration. Passion. Opportunities for growth.
W-0A.reversed: Lack of willpower or vision. Setbacks and delays to begin new projects or achieve goals. Creative blocks. In relationships, suggests cooled passions, lack of commitment, or difficulty conceiving.

W-10.title: The Ten of Wands
W-10.upright: Burdened. Overwhelmed. Strengths. Carrying too much responsibility alone. Feeling burned out. Nearing the end of a challenging cycle.
W-10.reversed: Sustained stress. Unwillingness to put your burden down. Inability to prioritize. You may be working to keep everyone happy without knowing what you personally want or need.

W-J1.title: The Page of Wands
W-J1.upright: Inspired. Enthusiastic. Good news. Need to express creativity. New ideas and possibilities. Running free, no restrictions.
W-J1.reversed: Blocked energy. Overindulgence in excitement. Can indicate that you or someone influencing you is refusing to focus on work that needs to be done or relationships that need to be tended to.

W-J2.title: The Knight of Wands
W-J2.upright: Impassioned. Enthusiastic. Inspired. Represents adventure and taking action. Inspiration and movement. Focus on achieving a goal.
W-J2.reversed: Competitive. Egotistical. Insecure. Too much fire fueling your personality or that of someone in your life. Can indicate Knight’s upright qualities are blocked due to insecurity.

W-KI.title: The King of Wands
W-KI.upright: Wise. Charismatic. Successful. Strong. Powerful energy. Confidence. Leader with maturity, vision, and achievement. Potential for long-term success and manifestation.
W-KI.reversed: Opinionated. Impetuous. Competitive. Controlling. Micromanaging. Tyrannical.

W-QU.title: The Queen of Wands
W-QU.upright: Visionary. Entrepreneur. Confident. Passionate. Energetic. Determined. Bold. Encourages expression and inspired action. Stands in self-empowerment.
W-QU.reversed: Strong-willed. Controlling. Might signal conflict with your mother or a strong-willed person in your life. Reconnect with the control you have to create your own projects.
